description: Set custom field values on an entity (contact, organization, or client group). Use list_custom_fields for the available definitions and get_custom_field_values to see what's currently set. Values are always passed as an array of strings, even for single values.

CustomFieldValues.description: The custom field values to set on the entity

Key.description: The custom field definition key (from list_custom_fields)

Name.description: The custom field name — alternative to Key

Value.description: The value(s) to set, as strings. Single-value fields take a one-element array.

name: set_custom_field_values
title: Set custom field values
